answer: Per-wallet lockbox with random relic audits: every new wallet locks 6 POA for 40 epochs, and each epoch 8% of locked wallets must answer a fresh pearl challenge that jurors score. An honest user ties up 6 POA, while 1,000 fakes tie up 6,000 POA. Rotating one funder through many wallets fails because the lock is charged per wallet. A failed audit forfeits 50%, so 1,000 fakes lose about 3,000 POA, and any juror can check each fable-length reply on chain.
